findings.text: follow-on: the suite arms logs/base-arm.log and logs/head-arm.log are truncated mid-run (65 and 70 progress dots, no pytest summary line and no EXIT= line) yet the reviewed run's manifest records baseline_suite.completed and after_suite.completed as true, so the recorded zero-failure delta cannot be read from the bytes on disk; the truncation dates to the run being SIGKILLed at 2026-10-02T10:03:25Z during the arm re-run. Fix: record completed:false for a log that never reached its summary, or re-run the arms at the reviewed head to completion and repoint the manifest.

follow-on: _unreconciled_live_runs re-implements the drain's per-pointer liveness-and-classification composition (local_liveness, classify_pointer over the process_alive override, closure_disposition_valid) rather than sharing one helper, so a future change to that composition in runs.drain will not propagate and the two can drift silently; the equivalence test guards only the fleet shapes it enumerates. Fix: extract the shared per-pointer composition into one function both call, or delegate the count to a runs helper.
